title: ToolEnvelope
description: TASK-011: Unified tool return envelope (per arch v2 section 5.3). All tools must return this shape to unify success/failure handling, truncation tracking, and untrusted data flagging.

ok.description: true = tool executed successfully; false = tool returned an error (see error.code).

oneOf.description: Success payload (tool-specific shape validated by tool's own schema).

error.description: Required when ok=false; null when ok=true.

untrusted.description: true = data field contains content from an external source (e.g., web page, clipboard). Per ADR-0034, untrusted data must NEVER be re-interpreted as instruction.

truncated.description: true = data field was truncated by length or token budget. Caller should treat downstream processing accordingly.
